made_with: Lab report, made with Ansatz from a video clip ({date})
name: Name
aim_text: To find the law that governs the motion in the clip, and to measure its constants with their uncertainties.
apparatus_text: A video clip ({frames} frames at {fps} fps, {size}); for scale, {scale}. Measurement by SAM 3.1 (Meta), one mask per frame.
method_1_top: The object (“{noun}”) was located in every frame; its position was taken as the top of its mask (for a jumper, the head, which arms and legs can’t drag around). Frame times were read from the video file.
method_1_centre: The object (“{noun}”) was located in every frame; its position was taken as the centre of its mask. Frame times were read from the video file.
method_2: {n} candidate laws were written as equations of motion and each was fitted to the first {pct}% of the motion.
method_3: Each fitted law predicted the remaining {pct}% of the motion, which it had not seen. Each law was ranked by the worse of its fit and its prediction, and the best was kept.
every: Every measurement of {n}; the full series is on the experiment page.
every_nth: One measurement in {k} of {n}; the full series is on the experiment page.
result_law: The law that best predicted the unseen motion: {law}.
conc_law: The motion is described by the law “{law}”, which predicted the part of the motion it had not seen better than every alternative tested.
conc_agree: The measured {q} agrees with the accepted value ({label}) within {pct}%, inside its uncertainty.
conc_differ: The measured {q} differs from the accepted value ({label}) by {pct}%, more than its uncertainty allows.
conc_clock: This points to the clip’s clock rather than the physics: the clip most likely plays about {f}× slower than real life.
prec_still: Keep the camera still, resting on a support, and film the motion side-on so it crosses the frame.
prec_plane: Keep the object of known size in the same plane as the motion, so one scale holds for both.
prec_light: Use bright light, so each frame is sharp and the object’s outline is clear.
prec_swing: Release the pendulum without pushing it, and keep the string taut.
prec_clock: Note whether the phone films in slow motion; the clip’s clock must be real time, or the factor stated.
